title: RBL TVS Credit Gold credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded TVS Credit Gold card rewarding automotive and fuel-related spends, with milestone benefits for vehicle owners.

items.child: Savor the finest dining experiences with 5% cashback on EazyDiner up to INR 250 every month.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.description: Savor the finest dining experiences with 5% cashback on EazyDiner up to INR 250 every month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the EazyDiner app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy 5% cashback up to ₹250 every month. Complete the payment using your RBL TVS Credit Gold credit card to unlock the offer.
